info.title: Gamified Learning System API
info.description: API for managing user authentication, course creation, content management, Course Learning, and system administration in a gamified learning platform.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User registration, login, logout, password reset, and multi-factor authentication endpoints

tags.name: Role Management
tags.description: Role-based access management for different user roles

tags.name: Course Management
tags.description: Endpoints for creating and managing courses and content

tags.name: Course Learning
tags.description: Endpoints for students to interact with content and track progress

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: System administration endpoints for user and course management

tags.name: Payment
tags.description: Endpoints for handling course payments and transactions

post.description: Register a new user with required details.
Authenticate a user and provide a JWT token.

401.description: Unauthorized request - user must be logged in.

post.description: Request a password reset link to be sent to the user's registered email.

404.description: User with specified email not found.

post.description: Verify an OTP sent to the user's registered phone or email for sensitive actions.

patch.description: Modify properties of an island, such as prerequisites and position.

post.description: Teachers can add levels with content such as quizzes, slides, and coding challenges to an island.

post.description: Students can submit answers for a quiz within a level, and receive immediate feedback.
